explain.journals: Journals come from OpenAlex. Search includes active journals and any book series or conference where your institution publishes. Open access type is calculated at query time using DOAJ for gold versus diamond, OpenAPC payments when they contradict a no-APC claim, and active institutional deals for hybrid.
explain.works: Publication counts and lists come from your university's Pure repository for the selected years, with retired records removed. Preprints, books, datasets, software, errata, and peer reviews are excluded, while book chapters stay in because conference proceedings often appear there. OpenAlex adds citations and open access status, and OpenAlex takes precedence when it disagrees with OpenAIRE.
explain.deals: Deal terms, caps, and dates come from openaccess.nl. Journal ISSN lists come from JCT/ESAC and signed contracts, such as the rebuilt 311-title Emerald list. Manual edits and excluded titles survive automated refreshes.
explain.apc: Prices come from OpenAlex, which publishes each journal's list price in one or more currencies, and otherwise from DOAJ, which publishes the highest APC. They are converted to euros at the 1 January exchange rate of the European Central Bank, or shown in their own currency when no rate exists. Without a list price, the price shown is the mean amount that institutions reported paying to OpenAPC. Articles that an agreement paid for (€0) are not part of that mean.
explain.greenOa: Self-archiving policies come verbatim from the Jisc Open Policy Finder. Routes that require an open access fee are excluded from free green open access, and prohibited journals always show as having no route. Funder compliance marks gold, diamond, and active deal journals as compliant.
explain.similar: Similar journals are ranked locally with the bge-small-en-v1.5 embedding model. Each journal vector is built from its cleaned title, its top five OpenAlex topics, and the titles of its three most cited works.
explain.authorWorks: Lists active publications registered for this author in your university's Pure repository. Preprints, books, datasets, software, errata, and peer reviews are excluded, while book chapters stay in. Each work is enriched by DOI with OpenAlex and OpenAIRE data, and OpenAlex takes precedence when the two disagree on open access status.
explain.crisGaps: Shows works that OpenAlex links to this author, journal, or unit whose DOI is missing from Pure. Authors are matched per shared publication using ORCID first and then exact name or initials, with guards against namesakes. Repository copies such as Pure itself and Zenodo are excluded, non-journal work types are filtered out, and book chapters are grouped under their parent book.
explain.collaborations: A partner is another organisation that your institution published with in the selected years. Partners are matched on identifiers only: OpenAlex lists the institutions on each work by ROR id, and a work with no OpenAlex institution takes its partners from OpenAIRE. Names, countries and map positions come from the Research Organization Registry (ROR).
